warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>,C1' — footing mark + the column C1 standing on it (C1 = 0.20x0.20, 4-DB12 on S-06). C1 is recorded here once (14 points); footing sizes on S-05: F1 0.50, F2 1.00, F3 1.20, F4 1.40 (all square) — the drawn boxes on this sheet measure the same at 1:50.

Three small F1 (0.50 x 0.50) post footings sit off the column grid: one above row A on line A'' (-1.00) at x 5.35 (foot of the back stair ST-02) and two below row C on line C' (7.50) at x 3.20 and 5.80 (foot of the front stair ST-01; the S-05 detail ST-1, ST-2 lands the lower end of the stair on a B3 beam over a post). Their y lines are printed (S-04 1.00 overhang ticks, matched to the millimetre in the vector data); their x positions are printed nowhere and were scaled from the S-01 vector geometry — grid master lines 2', 2''', 2'''' carry scaled_from_grid, so F1 confidence is lowered.
No footing at C4: the plan is L-shaped (bay B-C x 3-4 is outside the building).
